newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends barely changed in thin market.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends barely changed in thin market.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES -Prices drifted in a seven-ringgit range before closing almost unchanged as participants stayed away, waiting for leads from Chicago soyoil tonight. Lack of buyers interest in products and cash also limited activity. September will continue to trade in a range of 1,150 to 1,170 as demand remains slow.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Interest seen among nearby CPOs and selected oils. Some refiners covering seen at lower levels.
"Prices did open slightly higher and it was because of a rebound in soyoil last night," a trader said, but thereafter prices moved in a tight range.
"The next data the market expects is a crop report from Ivan Wong for June crop estimates," another trader said. He is expected to release the data either on Friday or Monday.
"Technically, the market is consolidating at current levels," a trader said. September futures contract traded between a range of 1,150 and 1,170 ringgit level.
September futures contract closed one ringgit up at 1,156 ringgit ($458.03) a tonne.
